During this first `DecodeDirect<unsigned short>::decode()` call, each `unsigned short` code unit is appended through the overload that defaults `FilterChar.width` to 1 (`FilterCharVector::append(FilterChar::Chr)` and `FilterChar(Chr, Width=1)`), even though each input element consumed 2 bytes. `proc_str_` therefore preserves code points but loses the original byte-width bookkeeping.

Tokenizer position bookkeeping reconstructs source spans by repeatedly adding `cur->width` while skipping non-word characters and while advancing through the word body.
